info.title: API.SH: PetSmart
info.description: The PetSmart API from API.SH: public PetSmart data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
PetSmart's category tree with product counts: every category path two levels below `parent` (or the top two levels), with its name, depth, number of products and link. Use a path as `category` in /petsmart/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A category path such as Dog > Food; default the whole store.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One petsmart.com product with every size or flavor variant: name, brand, link, full description (HTML and text) with its labeled sections split out (ingredients, guaranteed analysis, caloric content, feeding instructions and chart, features), rating and review count, price range, category and breadcrumbs, option values, catalog attributes (life stage, kibble size, health considerations, series…), package dimensions, manufacturer and images. Each variant has SKU, options, UPC, price, list and sale price, autoship prices and discount, online stock, delivery methods (ship, store pickup, same-day delivery), purchase limits, images, videos and promotions. With `store_id`, each variant also gets its quantity on hand at that store.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PetSmart product id: the number at the end of a petsmart.com product link (…-36648.html). A variant SKU or the link itself also works.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: PetSmart store number: adds each variant's quantity at that store.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer questions about one petsmart.com product, each with its answers (text, date, nickname, brand or staff answer flag, best-answer flag, helpful votes, photos). Includes the product's question and answer counts. Sort by newest, oldest, most answered or most helpful; only answered questions or questions containing words. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-questions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PetSmart product id: the number at the end of a petsmart.com product link (…-36648.html). A variant SKU or the link itself also works.

parameters.name: answered
parameters.description: true: only questions that have answers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one petsmart.com product with the product's average rating, review count, recommended and not-recommended counts, star distribution and averages of the secondary ratings. Each review has rating, title, text, date, nickname and location, recommended flag, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and incentivized flags, badges, secondary ratings (quality, value…), pet details the reviewer gave, photos, videos and PetSmart's replies. Sort by relevance, newest, oldest, highest, lowest or most helpful; filter by stars, photos or words. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: PetSmart product id: the number at the end of a petsmart.com product link (…-36648.html). A variant SKU or the link itself also works.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars.

get.description:
Search the petsmart.com catalog by keywords, category, brand or pet, with every filter the site's search page offers. Each product has id, SKU, name, brand, link, image, price and was-price (or the price range across sizes), rating and review count, category paths, pet, variation summary (sizes, flavors), UPC, manufacturer, autoship and same-day-delivery eligibility, pickup and in-store flags, how many stores stock it, promotions and the full catalog record in `raw`. The response also carries the filter values with counts (`facets`) and the price range of the matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when category, brand or pet is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path as on the site, e.g. Dog > Food > Dry Food (see /petsmart/v1/categories).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name; several separated by | (any of them).

parameters.name: pet
parameters.description: Pet type: Dog, Cat, Fish, Bird, Reptile, Small Pet; several separated by |.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: More filters as name:value pairs separated by ; (several values of one name joined by |), using the names in `facets`, e.g. dogLifestages:Adult;kibbleSizes:Small Breed|Medium Breed. Short names: lifestage, flavor, health, nutrition, form, kibble_size, color, pet_size.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Only products in stock at this PetSmart store (store number from /petsmart/v1/stores).

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: false leaves out the filter values (smaller answer). Default true.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: PetSmart store stock for an item
get.description:
Where one PetSmart item (a variant SKU from /petsmart/v1/product) is on hand near a ZIP code, city or point: each nearby store with its quantity, in-stock flag, distance, address, phone, hours and pickup and same-day delivery flags, plus how many of the stores on the page have it. `in_stock=true` keeps only stores that have it. 12 stores per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-stock

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A US ZIP code or a city such as Phoenix, AZ (or pass lat and lng instead).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, with lng, instead of zip.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only stores that have the item.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One PetSmart store: name, store page link, address, phone, coordinates, time zone, opening date, Google place id, regular weekly hours and the coming week's hours, store programs and every service (grooming, training, PetsHotel, Doggie Day Camp, vet clinic…) with its own hours and booking link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store number (from /petsmart/v1/stores) or a store page link (…-store1120.html).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
PetSmart stores near a ZIP code, a city or a point, nearest first: store number, name, store page link, address, phone, coordinates, time zone, opening date, distance, the coming week's hours, services (grooming, training, PetsHotel, Doggie Day Camp, vet clinics…) with their hours and booking links, and pickup, same-day delivery and autoship flags. With `sku`, each store also has that item's quantity on hand. 12 stores per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/petsmart-stores

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A US ZIP code or a city such as Phoenix, AZ (or pass lat and lng instead).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, with lng, instead of zip.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A product variant SKU: adds its quantity in each store.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
